'''PharmCom Orbital Processing Plant One''' was a pharmaceutical production facility located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], flew by this station during an operation to secretly transport several [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].
